# OpenShop documentation

OpenShop is a Shopify integration framework for typed providers, checkpointed
background flows, Shopify Admin GraphQL, proxy routes, webhooks, Functions,
PostgreSQL state, an embedded admin UI, and MCP capabilities.

## Start here

- [Overview](https://docs.openshop.run/)
- [Build your first app](https://docs.openshop.run/tutorials/first-app/)
- [Architecture](https://docs.openshop.run/concepts/architecture/)
